description: How much weight two funds hold in common, as published on their comparison page. Use to ask whether two ETFs are the same thing. Refuses rather than estimating when the pair is not compared or a holdings book is incomplete.

a.description: The first fund ticker, such as SMH.

b.description: The second fund ticker, such as SOXX.

name: etf_overlap

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.
